text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Robert Mugabe on Monday said countries of the south should pool their legal and financial resources together to ward off the destabilisation of currencies of some countries by financial powerhouses of the north.
- Zimbabwe and South Africa are expected to sign a trade agreement next Tuesday set to boost agricultural exports to the latter by at least Z$480 million.
